project: YC Archive - Data Sources & Homepage Redesign
description: Optimize API architecture by splitting SerpAPI/Serper to maximize free tiers. Add new data sources: Product Hunt, Hacker News, tech blogs, company discovery. Migrate Reddit to RSS (free, unlimited). Redesign homepage for mega-sleek single-purpose UX. Comprehensive execution polish for flawless experience.

userStories.title: Create Serper API integration
userStories.description: Create Serper client for Google News search and company discovery. This frees up SerpAPI budget for Google Trends only.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /lib/serper.ts with searchNews and searchWeb functions
searchNews fetches from https://google.serper.dev/news POST endpoint
searchWeb fetches from https://google.serper.dev/search POST endpoint
Both use X-API-KEY header with SERPER_API_KEY env var
Both accept query string and return SerperResult[] with title, link, snippet, date
userStories.notes: Serper has 2,500 free searches/month vs SerpAPI's 250

userStories.title: Migrate Google News from SerpAPI to Serper
userStories.description: Update news data source to use Serper instead of SerpAPI, freeing SerpAPI for Trends only.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintain same return interface for compatibility
userStories.notes: Saves SerpAPI budget for Google Trends

userStories.title: Create company discovery via Serper
userStories.description: Create function to discover non-YC competitors using AI anchor + Serper searches. Searches for alternatives and G2/Capterra listings.
acceptanceCriteria: getAnchorCompany(idea) uses Claude to identify one well-known competitor
extractCompaniesWithAI parses search results into structured company data
Returns array with name, description, status (active/acquired/dead/unknown)
userStories.notes: Uses 2 Serper searches + AI extraction per validation

userStories.title: Migrate Reddit to RSS feeds
userStories.description: Replace Reddit JSON API with RSS feeds for unlimited free access. Reddit's API has rate limits but RSS is unrestricted.
acceptanceCriteria: Install rss-parser package: npm install rss-parser
Search subreddits: startups, SaaS, Entrepreneur, smallbusiness
Parse RSS items to extract: title, link, date, source (subreddit), snippet
userStories.notes: RSS is free and unlimited vs blocked API

userStories.title: Add Hacker News RSS integration
userStories.description: Add Hacker News as new data source using hnrss.org for search.
acceptanceCriteria: Create searchHackerNews function in /lib/data-sources/reddit.ts or separate file
Parse RSS items to extract: title, link, date, source ('Hacker News'), snippet
userStories.notes: HN is valuable for tech community sentiment

userStories.title: Create Product Hunt integration
userStories.description: Add Product Hunt as data source to find launched products similar to the idea.
acceptanceCriteria: searchProductHunt(query) uses GraphQL API at api.producthunt.com/v2/api/graphql
Query posts(first: 10, query: $query) with fields: name, tagline, url, votesCount, createdAt, website
Returns PHProduct[] with name, tagline, url, votesCount, createdAt
userStories.notes: PH shows launched products - free with 6,250 pts/15min

userStories.title: Update validation API to use all data sources
userStories.description: Update /api/validate to fetch from all new data sources in parallel.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch in parallel: YC, Product Hunt, Trends (SerpAPI), News (Serper), Competitors (Serper), Reddit (RSS), HN (RSS)
Pass all data to AI analysis
Update report data structure to include phProducts, competitors, hnPosts
userStories.notes: Cost per validation: 1 SerpAPI + 3 Serper + free sources

userStories.title: Update AI analysis to include new data sources
userStories.description: Update OpenAI/Anthropic prompt to analyze Product Hunt, competitors, and HN data.
acceptanceCriteria: Update generateAnalysis function to accept phProducts, competitors, hnPosts
Update system prompt to analyze Product Hunt launches
Add section for competitor landscape from discovered companies
Include HN discussions in sentiment analysis
